title: poa alpina subsp. brevifolia
intro: Poa alpina subsp. brevifolia, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, aiding in the treatment of various health conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Fescue are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
